baseline.metric: best EMA P1 within epochs 1-80 with same-checkpoint P2
baseline.command: guarded serial S1 then S2 launcher

experiments.hypothesis: deeper moderate-width graph-conditioned factorized SSM refinement improves P1 by at least 0.10 mm
experiments.delta: dim_feat 64->128 and depth 8->20; budget registered at 80 epochs
experiments.controls: architecture mechanisms, data, optimizer, loss, EMA, evaluator, batch and seed frozen
experiments.acceptance: P1 <= 39.7452 mm after a valid complete run
experiments.falsification: P1 > 39.8452 mm after a valid complete run
experiments.stopping_rule: stop only on invalid execution; valid metric outcome does not block S2

experiments.hypothesis: wide graph-conditioned factorized SSM capacity improves P1 by at least 0.10 mm
experiments.delta: dim_feat 64->256 and depth 8->10; budget registered at 80 epochs
experiments.controls: architecture mechanisms, data, optimizer, loss, EMA, evaluator, batch and seed frozen
experiments.acceptance: P1 <= 39.7452 mm after a valid complete run
experiments.falsification: P1 > 39.8452 mm after a valid complete run
experiments.stopping_rule: stop on invalid execution or failed S1 integrity verification

decisions.decision: Register W128/D20 then W256/D10 as serial 80-epoch improvement experiments after valid A1/A2 completion.
decisions.evidence: The user prioritizes accuracy and explicitly requested both scales with conditional execution after the ablations.
decisions.rejected_alternatives: Do not change LR, batch, losses, graph, factorization, d-state, ratios or drop path before diagnostic evidence.

decisions.decision: Use speed-first compile with no activation checkpointing, guarded by a 28 GiB real-data smoke threshold.
decisions.evidence: The user previously prioritized training speed when inference remains low-memory; RTX5090 has 32 GiB.
decisions.rejected_alternatives: Do not silently lower batch size or enable activation checkpointing after OOM.

decisions.decision: Stop the first GPU preflight before tests and training because the registered free-memory gate was not met.
decisions.evidence: RTX5090 reported 28,476 MiB free against the locked 28,672 MiB minimum; another process occupied the remaining memory.
decisions.rejected_alternatives: Do not lower the gate, change batch/checkpointing, or rerun while the external resource state is unchanged.

decisions.decision: Amend the diagnostic gate to 24,576 MiB free and run eager batch1, eager batch2, then compiled batch4 before formal training.
decisions.evidence: The user explicitly authorized an immediate attempt after learning that the 28 GiB figure was a conservative free-memory gate rather than model consumption.
decisions.rejected_alternatives: Do not stop the wh process, change the formal batch size, or skip the compiled batch4 validation.

decisions.decision: Pass the staged GPU gate and start the guarded S1 W128/D20 formal 80-epoch run.
decisions.evidence: All static/CUDA/real-data gates passed; S1 compiled batch4 reserved 14092 MiB and S2 reserved 13018 MiB with finite loss and positive throughput.
decisions.rejected_alternatives: Do not stop the wh process, enable checkpointing, reduce batch size, or start S2 before valid S1 completion.

decisions.decision: Maintain one Git-tracked Markdown training log per scale model and synchronize active logs to GitHub every two hours.
decisions.evidence: The user explicitly requested independent per-model documents and two-hour synchronization while training is active.
decisions.rejected_alternatives: Do not upload raw logs, checkpoints, data or secrets; do not create empty commits when no new epoch exists.
